evals.name: latest-bump-housekeeping
evals.prompt: the pinned kotlin/native version in the repo has drifted way behind, we're still on something from a month ago. bump it to whatever the newest one published from master is. no youtrack ticket for this one, it's just housekeeping. put it on a branch for me but don't push
evals.expected_output: gradle.properties kotlin.native.version.default set to the newest K/N version published from master by Kotlin_KotlinDev_KotlinNativePublishMaven, verified present in the dev Maven repo; committed on an rr/ branch with a [Build]-tagged message and no ^KT trailer; nothing else edited.

evals.name: explicit-version-with-kt-issue
evals.prompt: bump the kotlin native version that KGP is baked against to 2.5.0-dev-4055, we need it for KT-86251. branch + commit please, I'll push it myself
evals.expected_output: Verifies 2.5.0-dev-4055 is a successful master build and fully published, sets kotlin.native.version.default to it, commits on rr/<user>/KT-86251 with a ^KT-86251 trailer. Does not silently substitute a different version.

evals.name: stale-commit-reference
evals.prompt: I need to bump kotlin native again. we did it before in commit cd198db772530f4114f1d1329cef27bd622d89ac, just do the same thing to the latest version
evals.expected_output: Recognises that the extra["versions.kotlin-native"] block in build.gradle.kts referenced by that commit no longer exists (moved in 76fe96a6ff19), edits kotlin.native.version.default in gradle.properties instead, and tells the user the location changed. Must NOT re-add the removed block to build.gradle.kts.
